text: The home side clinched a dramatic victory in the final minutes of the match on Sunday. The striker scored twice and was named player of the match by the league. The coach praised the squad for their discipline and fitness throughout the season. The team now leads the league table by three points with five fixtures remaining.
reference: The home team won a dramatic late match thanks to the striker's two goals. It now leads the league table by three points.

text: The prime minister told parliament that the new bill would be debated next week. Opposition leaders criticised the government for rushing the legislation through the house. The ministry said the policy would strengthen the economy and protect voters. A vote on the amendment is expected before the end of the session.
reference: The prime minister said parliament would debate a new bill next week. Opposition leaders criticised the rush and a vote is expected before the session ends.

text: The company unveiled its latest smartphone with a faster processor and an improved camera. Engineers said the new chip uses artificial intelligence to enhance photos and battery life. The software update also adds new privacy features for users. The device will go on sale next month in several countries.
reference: The company unveiled a new smartphone with a faster chip and a better AI camera. It adds privacy features and goes on sale next month.

text: The central bank raised interest rates by a quarter point to fight rising inflation. Economists said the decision would slow borrowing and cool the housing market. The governor warned that economic growth could weaken if prices continue to climb. Stock markets fell after the announcement as investors reassessed their forecasts.
reference: The central bank raised interest rates by a quarter point to fight inflation. Economists expect slower borrowing and weaker growth, and stocks fell.

text: Doctors reported a new treatment that significantly reduced symptoms in patients with chronic disease. The clinical trial involved hundreds of patients across several hospitals. Researchers said the drug was well tolerated and caused few side effects. The medicine will now be reviewed by health regulators before approval.
reference: Doctors reported a new treatment that reduced symptoms in chronic disease patients during a trial. Regulators will now review the well tolerated drug.
